items.title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
items.description: The French president says he has tasked the government with protecting critical infrastructure and defence industry sites.

items.title: Three dead and eight injured in Philippines school shooting
items.description: The gunman is among the dead in what is the third school shooting in the country since June.

items.title: Police begin operation to move migrants from Ceuta beaches
items.description: Police reportedly fired into the air on Friday morning as they struggled to contain crowds jostling to secure a place at the tented site.

items.title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
items.description: It is the first time the juror, who refused to side with the others and acquit Clancy, has spoken publicly about his decision.

items.title: At least 16 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams into Pakistan mosque
items.description: A vehicle loaded with explosives rammed into a mosque building during Friday prayers, a senior police official says.

items.title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
items.description: A spotted wildcat long mistaken for relatives has been identified as a new species in Bolivia.

items.title: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
items.description: Authorities linked the deaths to disease, but this has been disputed by intelligence reports and relatives of the accused.
